Author: Abhay S. Oka
Bench: Abhay S. Oka
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition (Criminal) No.81 Of 2023
 Manish Kumar Singh & Ors. P
 Versus
 Vijeta Rashmi @ Mrs. Vijeta Rashmi
 Manish Kumar Singh Re
 O R D E R

1. Perused the Settlement Agreement dated 26th July, 2024 signed by the first petitioner-husband,
the respondent-wife and their respective advocates in the presence of the learned Mediator attached to the Supreme Court Mediation Centre who has also signed the Settlement Agreement.
In terms of clause 5(A) of the Settlement Agreement, today a Demand Draft No.240903 dated 4th November,

2024 drawn in favour of the respondent-wife has been handed over to the learned counsel appearing for the respondent who, in turn, has handed over the same to the respondent who is personally present in the Court.
Even the first petitioner is present in the Court.
Both agree that they have signed the Settlement Agreement.
2. The marriage between the first petitioner-Manish Kumar Singh and the respondent-Vijeta Rashmi was solemnized on 15th July, 2021.
They are residing separately since 22nd August, 2021.
They have come to the conclusion that the marriage has irretrievably broken down.
All the pending disputes have been settled.
3. Therefore, this is a fit case to exercise jurisdiction of this Court under Article 142 of the Constitution of India by dissolving the marriage.

Accordingly, we direct that the marriage between the first petitioner-Manish Kumar Singh and the respondent- Vijeta Rashmi @ Mrs.Vijeta Rashmi Manish Kumar Singh solemnized on 15th July, 2021 is hereby dissolved by a decree of divorce by mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
